description: One-command Docker deployment: docker compose up --build installs everything, pulls the newest source from GitHub on every start (code only), and keeps all local data in named volumes so updates never lose anything.
features: Single command on any machine: docker compose up --build, console on http://localhost:7777/.
All local data lives in named volumes (x5-data, x5-models) — rebuilds and updates never delete them.
Every start refreshes source from GitHub (git pull --ff-only); offline continues with the baked code.
Embedding weights download once into the models volume, then persist across rebuilds.
Image holds code only — live data, weights binaries and secrets are excluded by .dockerignore.
